description: The kernel as a Language: Languages that extend Languages, Entities that extend Entities, and Relationships as pairs of named ends with ranges, plus the formulas written over them (docs/foundation.md, Part I).

axioms.about: Relationship ends are in the vocabulary of the Relationship's Language
axioms.formula: all r in Relationship, e in r.ends. e.entity.language in r.language.*extends

axioms.about: An Entity extends only Entities of the Languages its Language extends
axioms.formula: all e in Entity, b in e.extends. b.language in e.language.^extends

axioms.about: A formula mentions only Entities of its Language's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all f in Formula, x in f.mentionedEntities. x.language in f.language.*extends

axioms.about: A formula mentions only ends of its Language's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all f in Formula, x in f.mentionedEnds. x.relationship.language in f.language.*extends

axioms.about: A constraint is on a Relationship of its Language's vocabulary
axioms.formula: all f in Formula, r in f.constrains. r.language in f.language.*extends

axioms.about: min <= max, where max is present
axioms.formula: all e in End, m in e.max. m in e.min.*successor

axioms.about: Bounds are well-founded: no Bound succeeds itself
axioms.formula: all b in Bound. not b in b.^successor

axioms.about: In every Language, from any Entity, the named ends reachable across its vocabulary, its own and those of what it extends, have distinct names
axioms.formula: all x in Entity, y in x.*extends, z in x.*extends, na in y.ends, nb in z.ends, a in na.relationship.ends, b in nb.relationship.ends. (a != na and b != nb and a != b and (some l in Language. x.language in l.*extends and a.relationship.language in l.*extends and b.relationship.language in l.*extends)) => (no a.name or a.name != b.name)
all l in Language. not l in l.^extends
all e in Entity. not e in e.^extends
